entries.title: SSLC Mission Control demo container (provision-entity-exo3 template)
entries.description: Built multi-entity Docker container pattern for MC. New entities (SSLC, future JV partners) get isolated MC+ERP via `provision_entity_exo3.sh`: separate SQLite ERP, Docker volume, Cloudflare tunnel ingress, CF Access OTP policy, launchd watchdog, nightly backup lane. Demonstrates MC as platform, not just Exos internal tool.
entries.impact: Enables $0-cash MC demo for SSLC board; ERP/MRP runs with realistic helium-tank manufacturing demo data; positions MC for portfolio-company licensing.
